The '''Rasaaran storage facility''' was a facility used by many criminals as a base of operations. The smuggler [[Tyrodall]] had an operation inside the facility of smuggling Tarisian relics to Imperials.

==Behind the scenes==
The Rasaaran storage facility appears in a mission for the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class on Taris in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]]. A [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] option presented by [[Watcher One]] to the player, the mission has the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] raid the storage facility in order to recover Jedi artifacts that the Death's Claw were selling to a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. The facility also appears in a [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]] mission; the text for the Jedi Knight mission misspells the facility's name as Raarsan.
